title: Grugnetto’s friends
subtitle: They all play differently. Tap ⓘ to get to know them.
note: These descriptions come from simulations on the current board. They describe behaviour here, not labels written by the original KludgopolB author.

Zilla.label: Expert strategist
Zilla.description: Strong and consistent. He performs well both in duels and at a crowded table.
Zilla.bestFor: a serious challenge without picking the outright champion

Queen.label: Balanced expert
Queen.description: Solid and well-rounded, with no obvious weak spot. In duels she is almost level with Zilla.
Queen.bestFor: a strong opponent who is still readable

Wallace.label: Champion
Wallace.description: The most dangerous duelist and still one of the very best when more players join in.
Wallace.bestFor: a real test of your game

Hans.label: Multiplayer specialist
Hans.description: The more players at the table, the more dangerous he becomes. In crowded games he is among the best.
Hans.bestFor: a busy table with plenty of competition

Mimrock.label: Intermediate
Mimrock.description: A decent opponent, but less ruthless than the veterans. He leaves room to learn and recover from mistakes.
Mimrock.bestFor: a fair challenge once you know the basics

Lost Soul.label: Unpredictable
Lost Soul.description: He can be surprisingly dangerous in a duel, but loses a lot of strength in crowded games. You never quite know what he will do.

Pazifik.label: Buy first, think later.
Pazifik.description: An old friend who loves owning almost anything that lands in front of him. He builds as soon as he can and stubbornly raises auctions one coin at a time. Do not expect clever deals.
Pazifik.bestFor: an easier, predictable challenge; games tend to flow better with more than two players

Lemming.label: Beginner
Lemming.description: He makes plenty of mistakes and is the easiest friend to face. Perfect while you are learning the game.
Lemming.bestFor: your first game or a relaxed match
